import numpy as np, warnings
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
def nm(pred): return np.mean((sigma-pred)**2)/np.var(sigma)
models={
'G': lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*np.log(T)+p[2]*T+(p[3]+p[4]*T)*eps**p[5]+p[6]*T**2,
'H': lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2+(p[3]+p[4]*T+p[5]*T**2)*np.log(eps+p[6]),
'J': lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*T)+(p[3]+p[4]*T)*(1-np.exp(-p[5]*eps))+p[6]*np.sqrt(eps)+p[7]*eps**2+p[8]*np.log(T)+p[9]*T,
'K': lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*np.log(T)+p[2]*T+p[3]*np.sqrt(eps)+p[4]*eps**2*(1+p[5]*T)+p[6]*np.exp(-p[7]*T)+p[8]*np.log(eps)+p[9]*eps*T,
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(2)
for name,f in models.items():
    best=None
    for s in range(20):
        p0=np.full(10,0.1)+rng.normal(0,0.3,10); p0[0]=30
        try:
            with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
                r=least_squares(lambda p:np.nan_to_num(f(p)-sigma,nan=1e3,posinf=1e3,neginf=-1e3),p0,max_nfev=3000)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception: pass
    print(name, nm(f(best.x)), np.round(best.x,4))
